labelled_by: development agent, manual reading of the title and (where present) the abstract
rule: relevant = the record is about an ICU/patient-monitoring device, measurement method, monitoring system or monitoring algorithm, or the engineering of one. Filings of such a device and vendor statements about one are relevant. A clinical study that merely uses monitoring data is not. boundary = a reasonable reviewer could go either way; excluded from precision and recall denominators.

sample.note: top20 = the records that the rules would put at the top of the default feed on 2026-11-18; random_publication = fixed-seed random publications; pubmed/fda/press = per-source strata.
